title: Abasenga Imana barahiye
intro: Umuhanuzi yubahwa yagendagenda mu bantu, abahamagara ku kuri. Benshi barahindukira mu ntambara, ariko uruzitiro rutoyi rw’abihebeye Imana rwarishuye uwo muhamagaro, rwiyemeza n’umutima wabo wose. Bageragejwe n’amakenga maze baragira ubwoba bwo kurondera ivyo bafungura mw’ijuru. Ukwihebera Imana kwabo kudahungabana kwacitse icigwa c’ukwizera kidahera. None abo bari bande?
clues: Twari umugwi mutoyi wahagurutse kugira ngo ushigikire ubutumwa bw’Imana mu gihe abantu benshi bariko baratemera.
Umuhanuzi yubahwa cane yaraje araduhamagara ngo duhagarare nk’abafasha mu nzira ya Allah.
Igihe umuhanuzi yabaza abazoba abashigikiye Ubumana, twarishuye ata gukekeranya.
Twarateye ubwoba gusaba umusi mukuru w’igitangaza wamanutse uvuye mw’ijuru kugira ngo ukomeze imitima yacu.
Umuhanuzi wacu yatwibukije kwubaha Allah nimba turi abemera nyakuri, yamara ivyo twasavye twicishije bugufi vyarashikirijwe.
Twari uruzitiro rw’imbere rw’abanyamwete rwasezeranye ukwizera kudahungabana iruhande ya Isa mwene Mariyamu.

trial.label: Igerageza/Ivyabaye
options: Gusabwa kuba abashigikiye inzira ya Allah
Kuba yategetswe gukiza ingamiya y’ingore y’igitangaza .
Guhunga mu mwobo kugira ngo ntibatotezwe .
Kujabuka uruzi kugira ngo umuntu agerageze ukugamburuka
trial.answer: Gusabwa kuba abashigikiye inzira ya Allah

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوٓا۟ أَنصَارَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ لِلْحَوَارِيِّـۧنَ مَنْ أَنصَارِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَـَٔامَنَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَكَفَرَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ ۖ فَأَيَّدْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ عَلَىٰ عَدُوِّهِمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ ظَـٰهِرِينَ
verse: O you who have believed, be supporters of Allāh, as when Jesus, the son of Mary, said to the disciples, "Who are my supporters for Allāh?" The disciples said, "We are supporters of Allāh." And a faction of the Children of Israel believed and a faction disbelieved. So We supported those who believed against their enemy, and they became dominant. (61:14)
